text_block_list.text:
While operating the VR Umulator,
it began malfunctioning. Just then――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It just reset to the default settings.
Don't worry, you didn't break the equipment.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ――Alright, now we can get out of this virtual space!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Safely returned to the real world, I see. I take it you mixed up the controls with the dedicated "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" machine.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't worry about it.
As part of the Academy Enrichment Division,
I was only doing what's expected of me.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Think of me as a troubleshooter for your dreams!
Even if you stumble on your path, I'll be right beside you to sort it out!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: So lift your head high. You're going to lead them, aren't you? You're taking <chrname> beyond their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
All right, eyes forward. If you want to learn how to handle
trouble like this in the future, I can teach you. What do you say?

Afterward, thanks to her kind and easy-to-understand instruction,
I was able to properly absorb the knowledge.
